mapper.select: SELECT financial_asset, total_debt, created_at AS linked_at FROM financial_summary WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_summary ( member_id, financial_asset, total_debt, available_balance, annual_debt_payment, average_interest_rate, has_high_rate_debt, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{financialAsset}, #{totalDebt}, #{availableBalance}, #{annualDebtPayment}, #{averageInterestRate}, #{hasHighRateDebt}, #{linkedAt}, #{linkedAt} )

INSERT INTO pension_isa_account ( member_id, has_pension_saving, has_irp, has_dc, has_isa, pension_saving_balance, irp_balance, pension_annual_payment, irp_annual_payment, dc_annual_payment, isa_annual_deposit, tax_eligibility_status, isa_eligibility_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{hasPensionSaving}, #{hasIrp}, #{hasDc}, #{hasIsa}, #{pensionSavingBalance}, #{irpBalance}, #{pensionAnnualPayment}, #{irpAnnualPayment}, #{dcAnnualPayment}, #{isaAnnualDeposit}, #{taxEligibilityStatus}, #{isaEligibilityStatus}, #{linkedAt}, #{linkedAt} )

INSERT INTO financial_summary ( member_id, financial_asset, total_debt, available_balance, annual_debt_payment, average_interest_rate, has_high_rate_debt, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{financialAsset}, #{totalDebt}, #{availableBalance}, #{annualDebtPayment}, #{averageInterestRate}, #{hasHighRateDebt}, #{linkedAt}, #{linkedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE financial_asset = VALUES(financial_asset), total_debt = VALUES(total_debt), available_balance = VALUES(available_balance), annual_debt_payment = VALUES(annual_debt_payment), average_interest_rate = VALUES(average_interest_rate), has_high_rate_debt = VALUES(has_high_rate_debt), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
